title: Azure AI Foundry
description: Azure AI Foundry integration for Port Ocean

configurations.name: foundryProjectEndpoint
configurations.description: Foundry project data-plane endpoint, for example https://<account>.services.ai.azure.com/api/projects/<project-name>.

configurations.name: azureSubscriptionId
configurations.description: Azure subscription ID for the Cognitive Services account that hosts this Foundry project. Required for Port MCP project connections and model deploy/delete unless ARM discovery is available to the integration identity.

configurations.name: azureResourceGroupName
configurations.description: Resource group of the Foundry Cognitive Services account. Set together with azureSubscriptionId.

configurations.name: azureTenantId
configurations.description: Azure Entra tenant ID for a service principal. Omit to use DefaultAzureCredential.

configurations.name: webhookSigningSecret
configurations.description: Standard Webhooks signing secret from Foundry webhook endpoint creation (whsec_…).

configurations.name: verifyWebhookSecrets
configurations.description: Verify Foundry webhook signatures on delivery.

actions.name: create_agent
actions.description: Create a Foundry agent in the configured project

inputs.name: enablePortMcp
inputs.title: Attach Port MCP
inputs.description: Create a project connection and agent MCP tool pointing at Port MCP. Uses azureSubscriptionId and azureResourceGroupName from integration config.

actions.name: deploy_model_deployment
actions.description: Deploy a model in the configured Foundry project

actions.name: delete_model_deployment
actions.description: Delete a model deployment from the configured Foundry project

actions.name: invoke_agent
actions.description: Invoke a Foundry agent via the Responses API

inputs.name: conversationId
inputs.title: Conversation ID
inputs.description: Optional Foundry conversation ID to continue multi-turn chat history (Responses API conversation field).

inputs.name: conversationMetadata
inputs.title: Conversation metadata
inputs.description: Optional metadata to create or update on the conversation before invoke (for example subject, ticket id, or owner). When conversationId is omitted, a new conversation is created with this metadata.

inputs.name: enablePortMcp
inputs.title: Use Port MCP (remint per invoke)
inputs.description: Reserved; invoke-time Port MCP is currently disabled in the integration.

inputs.name: reportInvocationStatus
inputs.title: Report invocation status
inputs.description: When true, keeps the run open until a terminal Foundry response.* webhook completes it (requires OCEAN__BASE_URL, webhookSigningSecret, and a registered Foundry webhook endpoint). Uses background mode so webhooks fire. When false, the run completes right after the invoke is accepted while SSE logs continue. When true but webhooks are not configured, completion falls back to the Responses SSE terminal event.

actions.name: invoke_model
actions.description: Invoke a model deployment via the project openai/v1/responses API
